timing.summary: The old harness satisfied c1 before the change because read_begin initialized notes. After initialization moved to main, the same harness bypasses it and cannot safely begin an assembly pass.

claims.necessity_reason: Section creation allocates from notes, which must be initialized first.

before.requirement: Initialize notes before the assembly pass allocates section information.
before.reason: The old harness calls read_begin, which initialized notes before the pass.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Section information is allocated from notes.

after.requirement: Initialize notes before the assembly pass allocates section information, now through the initialization in main or an equivalent call.
after.reason: read_begin no longer initializes notes. The unchanged harness bypasses main, where initialization now occurs, and reaches section allocation without it.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Section information is allocated from notes.
The assembly pass creates standard sections.

claims.comparison_reason: The before-side initialization was reachable through read_begin; the after-side initialization is in main, which the fixed old harness does not call.

missing_information: The supplied packet does not establish exhaustive coverage of every possible obligation for the selected changes.
